text: これいじょうは　ない　くらい　なついて　いるのね…！

structure.jp: これいじょうは　ない　くらい
structure.en: so much that there is nothing beyond it

structure.jp: なついて　いるのね…！
structure.en: it is attached to you, isn't it...!

patterns.name: 〜くらい
patterns.span: これいじょうは　ない　くらい
patterns.explanation: くらい after a phrase says 'to that extent'. これいじょうは　ない　くらい = 'so much that there could be no more'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows a state that holds now. なついて　いる = 'is attached to you'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の after a verb shows the speaker is taking in what she sees and explaining it; ね here is a soft 'isn't it'. いるのね = 'so it is, isn't it'.
